metadata.title: Pedagogical practices and civic knowledge and engagement in Latin America: Multilevel analysis using ICCS data

extraction.outcome_summary: Using ICCS 2016 data from five Latin American and Caribbean countries, the study estimated hierarchical linear models linking pedagogical practices to students’ Civic Knowledge and Engagement (SCKE) scores. It found that several teaching/learning practice measures (e.g., openness in classroom discussions, civic learning at school, and civic participation measures) were significantly associated with SCKE, with directions varying by country. At the student level, expected educational attainment, home literacy resources, and gender were consistently related to civic knowledge, while expected active political participation showed a negative association with SCKE across countries. The analysis used multilevel modeling with ICCS sampling weights and included five plausible values for the cognitive outcome.
